name: TestcaseClassPerClass
summary: Puts the tests of one class under test into one testcase class, so that the test tree mirrors the production tree.

roles.name: TestcaseClassPerClass
roles.summary: The organisation that follows the code. It is the easiest to find and the least likely to say anything: a class with six responsibilities gets one testcase class with six unrelated fixtures, which is the pressure this choice hides.
